services.title: The support you need. All in one place.
services.text: Choose a service to see how we can help, what to prepare and how to get started.

cards.title: Personal Tax
cards.text: Personal tax returns, with the details of your life in mind. From employment and self-employment to rental income and family changes.

cards.title: Corporate Tax
cards.text: Keep your corporation's tax filings connected to its financial records, year-end needs and plans for the business.

cards.title: Bookkeeping
cards.text: Turn a stack of transactions into a clearer view of your business. Get support with ongoing records and catch-up bookkeeping.

cards.title: Trust & Estate
cards.text: Thoughtful tax support through important transitions. Understand the returns, records and next steps relevant to the estate or trust.

cards.eyebrow: For life between Canada & the U.S.
cards.title: Cross-Border Tax
cards.text: Bring both sides of your tax picture together. For people who live, work, invest or own property across the Canada–U.S. border.

more.title: More than one service in mind?
more.text: Your personal and business needs often connect. Tell us about the whole picture.

ways.title: A local team. Flexible ways to work together.
ways.text: Start online or meet us in person. Choose what works for you.

items.label: Online
items.title: File from wherever you are.
items.text: Start through LeadTax's remote filing experience. Contact us first if you need help choosing a service.

items.label: In person
items.title: Let's sit down together.
items.text: Arrange an office visit in Vancouver or Burnaby. Review current locations and appointment options before you visit.

process.title: From your first question to your next step.

steps.label: Choose
steps.title: Find your service.
steps.text: Choose the support you need, or speak with us. We'll discuss your situation, confirm the scope and provide a quote.

steps.label: Prepare
steps.title: Bring it together.
steps.text: Gather the relevant records. We'll explain the document-sharing process and follow up on missing information.

steps.label: Complete
steps.title: Review & move forward.
steps.text: Review the prepared work, ask questions and authorize applicable filings. Know what comes next.

items.question: Which service should I choose?
items.answer: Choose Personal Tax for an individual return, Corporate Tax for an incorporated business, and Bookkeeping for business records. Trust & Estate covers executor and trustee filing needs. Cross-Border Tax is for Canadian and U.S. tax connections. Contact us when your needs overlap.

items.question: Can you help with more than one service?
items.answer: Yes. Tell us about your personal, business and other filing needs so we can discuss the right engagement and coordinate the work.

items.question: How are fees determined?
items.answer: Fees depend on the services, years, records and complexity involved. We discuss the scope and quote before proceeding.
